reasons./approvals: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode'.
reasons./autoprune: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Turn automatic pruning of old sessions on or off'. This tree prunes old sessions at start-up when `sessions.auto_prune` is set in config (crates/hermes-cli/src/app/app_impl/construction.rs).
reasons./battery: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Toggle a color-coded battery indicator in the status bar'.
reasons./discard: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Drop a turn lost when Hermes restarted so this chat's queue runs again'.
reasons./egress: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Show Docker egress proxy status'.
reasons./export: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Export a profile (config, skills, theme) to a shareable archive'.
reasons./focus: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Toggle focus view — show only your prompt and the final response'.
reasons./heartbeat: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle'.
reasons./import: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Import a shared profile archive as a new profile'.
reasons./login: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Sign in with a Nous account (keeps your connectors)'. This tree signs in with `hermes auth nous` and reopens the portal login when a Nous token expires (crates/hermes-cli/src/app/app_impl/auth_context.rs).
reasons./loop: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session'.
reasons./palette: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Open the fuzzy command palette (also Ctrl+P)'.
reasons./pause: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Pause new work globally (emergency stop); '/pause off' resumes'.
reasons./refine: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Review this conversation now and save lessons to memory/skills'.
reasons./subscription: Changes a Nous Portal subscription plan through Nous's billing service; this port ships no Nous billing client and takes no payments.
reasons./topup: Buys Nous Portal credit through Nous's billing service; this port ships no Nous billing client and takes no payments.
reasons./wake: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Toggle the 'Hey Hermes' wake word listener'.
reasons./worktree: Not ported at the v0.23.2 re-pin. Upstream: 'Show, list, create, or prune isolated git worktrees'.
